paragraph: Draw a layered architecture for a shopping checkout. The browser web app calls the API gateway. The gateway sends identity requests to Auth and orders to Checkout. Auth reads the User DB. Checkout calls Inventory and Payments. Inventory reads the Catalog DB. Payments calls the Fraud service. Checkout publishes order events to the Event Bus. Notifications consumes events from the Event Bus. Put browser, gateway, services, data stores, and events into distinct layers.

rows.request: Twin, what does changing login touch?
Auth already uses Redis sessions instead of JWT.
We decided to migrate login to Redis sessions; Avery will own it.
Our web app talks to an auth service, and auth stores users in Postgres.
Our p95 latency went from 420 to 180 milliseconds after the cache.
What would the new login screen look like?

The database now uses SQLite instead of Postgres.
